---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new capability
title: "[feat] <one-line summary>"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem statement
What pain does this solve? Who experiences it? (As a <role>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>.)

## Proposed solution
Describe the change you have in mind. Include API shape, UI sketch or sample payload if known.

## Alternatives considered
Other ways to solve the same problem, and why they were rejected.

## Scope
- In scope:
- Explicitly out of scope:

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given ..., when ..., then ...
- [ ] Test coverage: unit / integration / manual E2E

## Risk & effort
- Effort estimate: S / M / L
- Breaking change? yes/no — migration plan if yes
- Affected components: (api, file, admin UI, POS app, docs)

## Additional context
Mockups, prior art, links.
